Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 84 units of ERIBULIN MESYLATE 0.5MG/ML 2ML SDV with a daily use of 4.8 units, providing 17.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list eribulin mesylate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 18 days. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Five alternative manufacturers have product not on the FDA shortage list today. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. discloses a plant (Kindos Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.) last inspected VAI 2024-07-19. Apotex Corp., BSP Pharmaceuticals SpA, Baxter Healthcare Company, and Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. labels name no plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Apotex Corp. — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify and place orders with BSP Pharmaceuticals SpA — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Baxter Healthcare Company — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. — requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose modifications at this time.
